note: Maps each health goal to the nutrients and herbs commonly discussed for that area, so the goal screen can show foods and herbs alongside supplements. A nutrient being relevant to an area is nutrition context, NOT a claim that eating it treats anything. Foods are ranked from USDA measured composition; herbs carry their own evidence level from herbs_seed.json.
disclaimer: Foods and herbs support a diet. They do not treat conditions.
